I farm here in the North West, and millet is what grows best on my land with the rains we get. I have some schooling and I own this plot, so I will put a little fertilizer to help the millet along — maybe one bag of urea split between this plot and my other small one. I will use my own seed saved from last season since improved millet seed is hard to find at the agro-dealer and costs too much. My wife and children help with weeding, but at harvest I will call two or three young men from the village for a few days.
